title: Prevented unsupported EPS-based P/E fallbacks
points: P/E answers now follow the production basis of market cap divided by selected annual or LTM net profit, and refuse to calculate a multiple from EPS, annualized interim EPS, share count, or historical shares outstanding.
No-reference SCS P/E cases no longer surface reference-warning Data checks blocks; they are explained as missing-input conditions when annual or LTM net profit is unavailable.
